stem: Which statement best expresses the main idea of paragraph 5?

options.label: A
options.text: Movies can cause people to become emotional.

options.label: B
options.text: The way people relate to a movie depends on how realistic it is.

options.label: C
options.text: Movies can make people ignore the difference between reality and fiction.

options.label: D
options.text: People lose awareness of their surroundings in a movie theater.
